---
name: "Data correction"
about: "Report a factual, methodological, or data error in a card"
title: "[correction] "
labels: "correction"
---

A correction is welcome. The lens is part of the data, and a wrong number is a wrong lens.

Keep it short. Be specific.

## Which card or tab
Name the card and the tab it lives in.

## What is wrong
Describe the error: a factual mistake, a methodological flaw, or a data issue.

## The correct value or method
State what the value or method should be.

## The source
A public, stable, reproducible link. If you use a secondary source, say why the original was not used.

## What the viewer should be careful about
Any caveat, incompleteness, or constructed category the viewer should know about.

---

See [the data standard](../../metasystemic/constitution.md) (section 10): every card answers where the data came from, how it was transformed, when it was last updated, and what the viewer should be careful about.
